philosophy: Hard constraints, heuristic warnings and artistic advice must never be conflated.

rules.text: Judge silhouette and subject recognition at final 1× size before adding microtexture; keep functional negative space.
Prefer readable connected pixel clusters. Single pixels must have a role; sparkles, eyes and particles are valid exceptions.
Choose a dominant light direction, then group shadows, base tones and light faces. Do not fix silhouette errors by adding colors.
Output only data. Palette symbols and every frame row must satisfy pixelweave/layered-v1 schema. Never output arbitrary code.
Non-target layers may not be changed during scoped repair. Every edit must use explicitly allowed frames, target layer and bounding box.
Glass needs structural wall thickness, edge-local highlights and a visible interior, not an opaque uniform white ring.
Keep glass, stopper and shadow silhouettes static when only liquid/bubbles are requested to animate.

Liquid and bubbles must not extend beyond the intended container/interior mask. Do not assume bbox alone is a complete containment mask. Currently only bubble-liquid overlap is automatically checked; full shape masks are a future feature.
Animate surface with small legible periodic changes, avoid unrelated redraw of the entire fill area; maintain plausible fill level.
Bubbles need lifecycle: emerge within liquid, rise, pop or fade near surface; do not teleport outside liquid at loop boundary.
Metal highlights are localized hard high-contrast shapes aligned to geometry and light source; not random yellow dots.
Anchor flame to wick or fuel and vary tip more strongly than base; static frame/metal should not jitter.
Build crystal facets as intentional planes; keep each facet coherent and use only a few focal glints.
Freeze flagpole and root anchor; movement grows toward fabric tip, folds follow main displacement.
Check F-last → F0 as another motion step; equal first/last frames are not required and may create a duplicate hold.
Plan key poses before in-betweens; more frames do not automatically improve action and can reduce energy.
Motion percentages and isolated pixel counts are diagnostics, never definitive aesthetics scores; annotate intended exceptions.
Avoid accidental pillow shading unless center-lit or intentionally glowing; support each brighter cluster with a light-source explanation.
Approve a composition thumbnail, main focal point, foreground/midground/background, and negative space before detailed assets.
Long-running wallpapers should keep background motion unobtrusive, avoid frequent full-frame flashing, and permit reduced motion.
Do not claim objective art quality from structural JSON tests or machine frame-diff numbers. Require independent visual review.
